whyMatters.en: Sheffield band that spent a decade underground before Different Class (1995) put Jarvis Cocker’s class-satire and glam-tinged arrangements on UK charts beside Oasis and Blur.
whyMatters.zh: 谢菲尔德乐队：地下十年后 Different Class（1995）把 Jarvis Cocker 的阶级讽刺与偏 glam 编曲送上英国榜，与 Oasis、Blur 并列。

shortBio.en: Jarvis Cocker Sheffield Britpop; Common People is the class-satire single, Different Class the chart document.
shortBio.zh: Jarvis Cocker 的谢菲尔德 Britpop；Common People 是阶级讽刺单曲，Different Class 是榜单文献。

body.en:
Formed 1978; commercial peak arrived mid-1990s after His ’n’ Hers (1994). Jarvis Cocker’s spoken-sung delivery, Russell Senior’s violin/guitar color, and Steve Mackey’s bass locked a literary Britpop pole against laddish stadium rock.

Different Class (1995) delivered Common People, Disco 2000, and Mis-Shapes—observational lyrics with glam keyboard lifts. They matter as Sheffield’s narrative counterweight to Manchester anthem bands.
body.zh:
1978 年组建；商业高峰在 His ’n’ Hers（1994）之后的 1990 年代中期。Jarvis Cocker 的说唱式演唱、Russell Senior 的小提琴/吉他色彩与 Steve Mackey 贝斯锁定文学 Britpop 一极，对位兄弟会式体育场摇滚。

Different Class（1995）交出 Common People、Disco 2000 与 Mis-Shapes——观察式歌词配 glam 键盘抬升。他们是谢菲尔德叙事对曼彻斯特颂歌乐队的配重。

note.en: His ’n’ Hers single; spoken narrative over keyboard swell.
note.zh: His ’n’ Hers 单曲；键盘铺底下的口语叙事。

note.zh: Jarvis 点名 Deborah；键盘主导的中速 Britpop 电台曲。

title.zh: 文学 Britpop 对兄弟会体育场

body.en:
Common People (1995) is verse reportage into a chant chorus—class tourism as pop structure, not sloganeering. Jarvis’s body language and lyric detail define a satirical Britpop lane.

Different Class sits beside Oasis/Blur as the observational, Sheffield-document side.
body.zh:
Common People（1995）是主歌报道推进到口号副歌——阶级观光作为流行结构，非口号堆砌。Jarvis 的肢体与歌词细节定义讽刺 Britpop 车道。

Different Class 与 Oasis/Blur 并列，是观察式、谢菲尔德文献面。

title.zh: Senior 时期到 Mackey/Banks 核心

body.en:
Russell Senior adds violin and angular guitar through Different Class; exits 1997 before This Is Hardcore. Mackey and Doyle’s keyboard/bass bed stays the harmonic frame.

Nick Banks (drums, 1991+) completes the peak five-piece silhouette.
body.zh:
Russell Senior 在 Different Class 前加入小提琴与棱角吉他；1997 年 This Is Hardcore 前离队。Mackey 与 Doyle 的键盘/贝斯床仍是和声框架。

Nick Banks（1991+ 鼓）完成峰值五人剪影。

title.en: Class narrative into later UK indie
title.zh: 阶级叙事进入后来英国 indie

body.en:
Pulp export observational lyric habits—character names, social detail, spoken verses—that Arctic Monkeys later cite in Sheffield continuity.

They are the Britpop pole that kept glam keyboards and satire over football-chant consensus.
body.zh:
Pulp 输出观察式歌词习惯——角色名、社会细节、口语主歌——Arctic Monkeys 后来在谢菲尔德延续线上引用。

他们是保留 glam 键盘与讽刺、而非足球口号共识的 Britpop 一极。
